main.description: ADR-2604261717 staked claim attestation. Posted via com.etzhayyim.claim.postStakedAttestation. Bond is locked in ClaimStakeEscrow on the etzhayyim private chain (chainId 260425). Game theory: EV(lie) = -P(challenge) * bond < 0 < EV(truth).

claim.description: Plain-text claim asserted by the claimant

claimType.description: claimant-supplied tag, e.g. factual / medical / whistleblower / company-registration

claimId.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte keccak256(claimHash || didHash || nonce). Joins AT Record to ClaimStakeEscrow.claims(bytes32)

chainId.description: EVM chainId where the bond is locked (260425 for etzhayyim private chain)

challengePeriodSec.description: Seconds during which counter-claims may be filed; default 604800 (7 days)

evidence.description: CIDs of supporting AT Records or blobs

outcome.description: unchallenged | upheld | slashed | refunded — set by com.etzhayyim.claim.resolution annotation
